answer: Rotating Challenge-Response Admission. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function derives a per-agent delta of challenge channels. An enrolling agent must answer a randomly selected channel's challenge within that epoch at a wharf endpoint, and the channel selection is unknown until the epoch seed is revealed. An attacker cannot precompute which channel or zephyr of traffic their fake identities will face, so each identity must maintain durable presence across all channels. This raises the marginal cost per identity to full multi-channel upkeep, collapsing bulk registration economics.
